rules.sentence: Histologically, telangiectatic osteosarcoma is characterized by numerous blood-filled sinusoids with septations containing cells with nuclear pleomorphism and numerous mitotic figures.[24]
The lesional tissue is also observed permeating into the surrounding marrow or cortex.[24]
This condition is a histological combination of Ewing sarcoma and osteosarcoma and features numerous small round cells.
Unlike Ewing sarcoma, spindling of tumor cells is seen with small-cell osteosarcoma.[24]
A minuscule volume of an osteoid matrix also distinguishes this as a variant of osteosarcoma.[24]
